name: Can Tho Museum
nameVi: Bảo tàng Thành phố Cần Thơ
kicker: City museum on Hòa Bình since 1976
summary: Use the museum on Hòa Bình when you want a roof and the standing collection, not a current exhibition list. Vietnam Tourism dates it to 1976, on 2,700 m², with about 5,000 objects and English captions. A fee, the hours, and the minutes from the quay were not printed. Check on arrival.
getThere: Walk from the quay along Hòa Bình. Minutes: Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The museum facade on Hòa Bình

notice.title: No current exhibition list
notice.body: Vietnam Tourism’s text is a standing description of the collection. It does not name a 2026 show. Do not plan the hour around a temporary display.

body: Vietnam Tourism says the museum was established in 1976, on 2,700 m², with about 5,000 objects: history of people in Can Tho, plant and fish specimens, and rice work of Kinh, Hoa, and Khmer people, with English captions. That is the visit the national account describes.

Two address lines are printed. The museum site’s footer says Số 1 đại lộ Hòa Bình, phường Ninh Kiều. Vietnam Tourism says no. 1 Hoa Binh Avenue, Tan An, Ninh Kieu. Both stay. A tariff was not on the national page. Hours were not printed. Check on arrival. The walk from Bến Ninh Kiều follows Hòa Bình. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.
